intro: 替小豬取名字，用每天的餵食、散步、聊天與打工，陪牠養成有故事的生活。「完美養豬」有吃貨豬、陽光豬、認真豬、夢幻豬與撒嬌豬五種個性，以及 100 張卡牌與結局故事。完成七天成長後，可以自行決定結算或繼續陪伴；迎接下一代時，收藏與資源會保留。
用家具布置房間、在衣櫃挑選裝扮，打造屬於你們的生活角落。打工賺取金幣，也可以選購寶石 App 內購項目。小豬聊天使用裝置上的預寫對話與規則，結合個性、互動紀錄及你告訴牠的偏好；日常養成可以離線進行。
需要連線的「豬友園地」可以認識其他玩家、聊天、約會與建立伴侶關係。交往與求婚需要雙方確認；結婚後可體驗婚禮儀式及紀念卡，也能在設定中確認離婚。遊戲支援繁體中文、簡體中文、英文、日文、韓文、法文、義大利文、德文、西班牙文與泰文共 10 種語言，通知由你決定是否開啟。
features: 七天成長，自選結算
餵食、散步、聊天與打工，逐步養成小豬的個性；完成七天成長後可結算或繼續陪伴，下一代保留收藏與資源。
五種個性與 100 張故事卡
吃貨豬、陽光豬、認真豬、夢幻豬與撒嬌豬；卡牌分為日常、工作、節慶與隱藏四個系列，收集卡牌與故事結局。
房間與裝扮
用家具布置房間，在衣櫃挑選裝扮。
豬友園地
連線認識其他玩家、聊天、約會與建立伴侶關係；交往與求婚都需要雙方確認。
婚禮與關係設定
結婚後體驗婚禮儀式與紀念卡，也能在設定中確認離婚。
離線養成與 10 種語言
日常養成可離線進行，豬友園地需要網路；支援繁中、簡中、英、日、韓、法、義、德、西班牙與泰文。
stepDetails: 第一次開啟時選擇語言與外觀，替小豬取名後進入豬舍。遊戲教學會說明照顧、打工，以及小豬成熟後可以選擇是否結算。
在豬舍選擇餵食、散步、聊天、劇情、摸摸或拍拍，每一項都會顯示今天還能成長幾次或增加多少親密。觀察小豬的心情與反應，不同的互動會影響親密度與個性走向。
到「打工」賺取金幣，再到「補給」補充食物，讓照顧持續下去。聊天時可以挑選話題（例如今天也陪你、點心研究會、被窩晚安話），用快速回覆或自己輸入一句話。持續照顧並留意成長進度，小豬成熟後再決定是否結算這一代。
結算後到「圖鑑」查看卡牌收藏與故事結局：100 張卡分為日常、工作、節慶與隱藏四個系列，會依養成條件逐步現身，也能依五種個性篩選。重讀已獲得的結局，下一代換個方式陪伴，解鎖還沒看過的卡牌。
more: 布置與裝扮
用家具布置房間、在衣櫃挑選裝扮，為每一代留下不同的生活角落。
豬友園地
分別設定主人暱稱與豬名，在 App 內建立園地身份；名片可設為公開或私密，依自己的步調認識其他主人。
好友與感情線
在需要連線的豬友園地認識其他玩家、聊天與約會。交往和求婚需要雙方確認；結婚後可體驗婚禮儀式與紀念卡，也能在設定確認離婚。
封鎖與檢舉
園地中會出現隨機 NPC 情敵，皆為虛構事件與角色；不想要的互動可用封鎖與檢舉處理，也能在 App 內刪除園地帳號。
換手機
舊 App 保持登入時，取得有效五分鐘、只能使用一次的配對碼，在新裝置接續園地身份。
小豬生活手帳
保存豬友合照與生活日記，參與合作任務、寄送明信片，布置房間並互訪，探索個性故事、每週活動及歷代回憶冊。
tips: 完成七天成長後，由你決定何時結算，也可以繼續陪伴；開始下一代會保留收藏與資源。
想集滿 100 張故事卡，每一代試著用不同的互動方式養成，解鎖不同個性的故事。
園地裡的情敵、互動與事件都是遊戲的虛構內容，不代表現實人物。
換手機前先確認舊 App 仍保持登入，配對碼只有五分鐘有效且只能使用一次。

intro: Name your piglet and give it a life with a story through daily feeding, walks, chats and part-time jobs. Perfect Pig has five personalities — foodie, sunny, earnest, dreamy and cuddly — and 100 cards with ending stories. After seven days of growth, choose when to finish the generation or keep spending time together; your collection and resources carry over to the next piglet.

Furnish its room and pick outfits from the wardrobe to build a corner of life that belongs to the two of you. Earn coins at work, with gems available as optional in-app purchases. Pig conversations use authored dialogue and rules on your device, drawing on personality, shared moments and preferences you have told it; daily care works offline.

Meet other players, chat, go on dates and become partners in the online Pig Pals Garden. Dating relationships and marriage proposals require both players to agree. Celebrate with a wedding ceremony and keepsake card, or confirm a divorce in Settings. Play in ten languages: Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, Italian, German, Spanish and Thai. Notifications are optional.
features: Seven days of growth, optional settlement
Feeding, walks, chats and jobs shape your piglet's personality. After seven days of growth, finish the generation or keep spending time together; collection and resources carry over.
Five personalities and 100 story cards
Foodie, sunny, earnest, dreamy and cuddly piglets; cards come in four series — everyday, work, festival and hidden — alongside story endings.
Room and wardrobe
Furnish the room and choose outfits.
Pig Pals Garden
Meet other players online, chat, date and become partners; dating relationships and marriage proposals need both players to agree.
Wedding and relationship settings
Celebrate a marriage with a wedding ceremony and keepsake card, or confirm a divorce in Settings.
Offline care and ten languages
Daily care works offline; Pig Pals Garden needs a connection. Play in Traditional and Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, Italian, German, Spanish and Thai.
stepDetails: On first launch, choose a language and appearance, name your piglet and enter the pig house. The tutorial covers care, part-time jobs and the option to settle a generation once the piglet matures.

In the pig house, choose feeding, a walk, a chat, a story scene, a stroke or a pat; each shows how much growth or closeness it can still add today. Watch the piglet's mood and reactions — different interactions shape your bond and the personality it grows into.

Earn coins through part-time jobs and restock food from the supplies tab so the care can go on. In chats, pick a topic — everyday company, snack research, bedtime talk and more — and answer with a quick reply or a line of your own. Keep caring for the piglet and watch its growth; once it matures, decide whether to settle the generation.

After settling, open the collection to see your cards and story endings: the 100 cards are split into everyday, work, festival and hidden series, appear gradually as you meet their conditions, and can be filtered by the five personalities. Reread the endings you have, then raise the next piglet differently to unlock the cards you have not seen.
more: Decorating
Furnish the room and pick outfits from the wardrobe to give each generation its own corner of life.
Pig Pals Garden
Set an owner nickname and a pig name separately and create a garden identity inside the app; make your profile card public or private and meet other owners at your own pace.
Friends and romance

Meet other players, chat and date in the online Pig Pals Garden. Dating relationships and proposals need both players to agree; marriage includes a wedding ceremony and keepsake card, and divorce can be confirmed in Settings.
Blocking and reporting
Random NPC rivals appear in the garden as fictional events and characters; handle unwanted interactions with block and report, and delete your garden account inside the app whenever you wish.
Changing phones
While the old app is still signed in, get a one-time pairing code valid for five minutes to continue your garden identity on the new device.
Piglet life journal

Keep Pig Pals group photos and daily diaries, join cooperative quests, send postcards, decorate rooms and visit friends, and explore personality stories, weekly events and a memory book across generations.
tips: After seven days of growth, choose when to finish the generation or keep spending time together; starting the next generation preserves your collection and resources.
To fill all 100 story cards, raise each generation differently and unlock the stories of every personality.
Rivals, interactions and events in the garden are fictional game content and do not represent real people.
Before changing phones, make sure the old app is still signed in; the pairing code lasts five minutes and works only once.
